name: skill-architect
description: Critical-thinking decomposition skill that runs before any new skill is authored. Detects task-vs-skill-vs-agent shape, surfaces every assumption, and decomposes into a layered set of 5–10+ skills before delegating to skill-creator. v0.3 adopts the Olympus SDLC inheritance pattern: Inherits-From headers on every abstract, folder-and-file nesting under domain, and READ-FIRST runtime preamble emitted into every authored SKILL.md.
